metrics.note: Decision #12 is 1/(1+relative spread), structurally bounded in [0,1]. Measured min 0.0084, median 0.5601, max 1.0000, zero negatives, 6.6 percent below 0.30. Low values are honest wide intervals on sparse series, not a bug.

negativeAccuracyDefect.concentration: Entirely sparse demand: negative rows have median 111 units across 13 origins and median zero-share 0.654, against 2,612 units and 0.038 for the rest.
negativeAccuracyDefect.finding: Row accuracy is 100*(1-WAPE) and leaves the 0-100 domain whenever absolute error exceeds total demand. 321 of 2,212 SeriesKeys were below zero, 21 below -100, worst -1049.2.
negativeAccuracyDefect.resolution: The percentage is withheld when WAPE > 1 and the row publishes accuracyState = error_exceeds_demand with its WAPE. Clamping to zero was rejected: it would hide which rows are catastrophically wrong versus merely useless. Follows decision #80 -- an out-of-domain metric is a state, not a badge.
negativeAccuracyDefect.verified: 0 negative cells in SKU View; 9 of 100 visible rows withheld with a reason tooltip.

purpose: Every displayed metric checked for grain correctness and domain validity.
quantileNote: P90 coverage is never aggregated. A sum of P90 bounds is not the P90 of a sum, so coverage is measured at SeriesKey grain everywhere and labelled. Summing produced a meaningless 1.00 which would have forced Action on every row, since all four decision #80 tiers require coverage inside a band.
